stem: BlueOrbit Retail sees a sudden rise in EC2 cost and the CFO wants a forecast by linked account and cost-center tag for next quarter.

choices.text: AWS Budgets with forecast threshold alerts
AWS Cost and Usage Report exported to Amazon S3 and queried with Athena
AWS Cost Explorer grouped by linked account and tag

rationale: Cost Explorer is built for visualization and forecasting with filtering and grouping dimensions such as account and tags. Budgets is best for threshold alerts and actions, not exploratory forecasting views. Cost and Usage Report is granular line-item export data for custom analytics, not the fastest interactive forecast tool for leadership. Cost Anomaly Detection flags unusual spend patterns rather than providing detailed quarter forecasting by selected dimensions.
